name: Tambacounda

routes.outcome: Official DGID site identifies fiscal/domain/cadastre responsibilities and lists CSF Tambacounda, Quartier Liberté, Tambacounda. This is local custodian evidence, not a public parcel API.

Official DGID NICAD procedure states that the cadastral bureau of the locality delivers the cadastral document and that NICAD identifies/localizes parcels. The page does not expose public parcel geometry or a query API.
Official DGID NICAD document describes the national parcel identifier and DGID cadastral-bureau responsibility. No parcel record or geometry was requested or retained.

Official Commune de Tambacounda procedure says the cadastral plan is obtained from the Cadastre and must certify the site plan. This confirms the local procedure/custodian relationship, not public map access.
Official ONDDL SIG/GeoNode portal loaded. It is a national territorial-data portal; no parcel layer was visible in the public dataset inventory.
Public WFS capabilities returned EPSG:4326 layers dep_pole_casamance, departement, and GADM administrative layers only. No cadastral/parcel feature type was listed.
Administrative departement schema returned safe fields fid/id and geom with GML 3.2 geometry; it is not a parcel schema. Native field names were not treated as parcel identity.

Bounded anonymous request returned a valid FeatureCollection with zero features. This is an administrative-layer extent result only; it is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence and no geometry was retained.
Official Géo Sénégal service description exposes BaseGéo WMS/WMTS references, but only general national visualization services were evidenced; no parcel identity+geometry service was found.
DNS resolution failed for the linked BaseGéo host during a bounded anonymous request. No retry escalation, login, credential, or TLS bypass was attempted.

schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: EPSG:4326 for ONDDL administrative layers; no parcel CRS resolved.
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: No parcel identity returned. Administrative schema contains fid/id, but neither is a parcel identity for this packet.
schemaAndCrs.sourceFieldMapping: ONDDL departement: fid/id/geom observed; not mapped as parcel fields.

boundedAnonymousResponse.requestScope: ONDDL administrative WFS bbox around exact WUP point

localCustodianAssessment: Local cadastral custodian is evidenced by the official DGID CSF Tambacounda listing and DGID NICAD procedure, reinforced by the official commune procedure directing applicants to the Cadastre for cadastral plans. No local public parcel viewer/API was evidenced.

qualification.reason: A local cadastral custodian is evidenced, but no anonymous public parcel identity/geometry service was qualified. Runtime adapter admission remains a separate serial review.

scopeLimits: Exact WUP point was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
The ONDDL zero-feature administrative response, map extent limitations, and unavailable BaseGéo host were not treated as citywide cadastral absence.
No full parcel polygon was returned, so no GeoJSON sample is retained.
